note: Source of truth for CHANGELOG.md. One row per shipped change: date + type are fields, not headings, so entries can be grouped, filtered and graphed. Rendered by scripts/docs.mjs.

changelog.title: Per-account coupon caps
changelog.detail: Tobi's partner codes need "useable three times by an account", which the table could not express — `max_uses` is a global total and `frequency_days` is a global cooldown. Added `coupons.per_user_limit` (`20261109000001_coupon_per_user_limit.sql`), enforced in `validateCoupon()` against `transactions.metadata->>submitter_id`, with a fallback to the caller's session so client-side previews check the right account. Admin create/edit/table gained a "Per account" field

changelog.title: Product-owner board
changelog.detail: token-gated `/product-owner` — pending questions + insight dump for Tobi (`app/product-owner/`, `app/api/product-owner/route.ts`, `components/product-owner/ProductOwnerBoard.tsx`, `20261028000001_product_owner_questions.sql`); later swapped to an embedded MerisLabs PM board for the multi-client system, with a middleware exemption so `/product-owner` skips the directory rewrite (`7454fc2`, `518a5e3`)

changelog.title: `docs/AUDIT-2026-10-20.md`
changelog.detail: full-repo audit — 3 critical (self-service admin promotion via unrestricted `profiles.role` UPDATE; leaked keys in git history; unauthenticated `/api/auth/hook` mail relay with HTML injection), high/medium findings on cron + payments + RLS, plus a suggested fix order

changelog.title: Every category page was dead
changelog.detail: `articles.category` became `TEXT[]` in `20260616000004`, but the query layer still filtered with `.eq('category', 'news')` — PostgREST answers `400 malformed array literal` and the error was swallowed, so `/insights?category=*` rendered empty and `/category/*` called `notFound()`. Added `categoryCandidates()` + `.overlaps()` in `lib/api/articles.ts` so a slug (`news`, `sports-law`) matches the label actually stored (`News`, `Sports Law`); applied at the insights page, category page, knowledge category page and related-articles query. Verified against production: news 1000+, opinions 235, judgements 30, sports-law 6, corporate-post 2

changelog.title: Corporate Posts listing starved by ordinary articles
changelog.detail: `app/directory/corporate-posts/page.tsx` pulled the 50 newest published articles and filtered in JS. Now filtered in Postgres via a new `articleType` option on `getPublishedArticles()`

changelog.title: "Corporate Posts" missing from the site's Categories nav
changelog.detail: the header dropdown (desktop + mobile) and the footer list were hardcoded to five/six legacy categories. Added Corporate Posts → `/category/corporate-post` in `components/Header.tsx` and `components/Footer.tsx`, plus a chips entry on `/insights`

changelog.title: Auth email links 404'd on the WordPress main domain
changelog.detail: supabase confirmation/magic-link/recovery links open `www.lawyard.org/auth/callback`, which is still WordPress (404 + a search form nobody reads). Added `app/auth/callback/route.ts` — forwards the whole query to `directory.lawyard.org/auth/callback` so the code exchange can run. The remaining half is a dashboard change: allow-list the directory URL in Supabase → Redirect URLs (D12)

changelog.title: OAuth-only accounts at login
changelog.detail: users who signed up with Google and had no password got a dead-end "Incorrect email or password" / "log in instead" on login/signup. Added `lib/auth/oauth-account.ts` (service-role lookup, fires only after a failed credential attempt — same enumeration surface as Clerk/Auth0 identifier-first flows) so they now see "This account signs in with Google. Continue with Google, or use 'Forgot your password?' to set a password." (`app/directory/login/actions.ts`)

changelog.title: Auth email hook built 404 verify links
changelog.detail: `buildConfirmationUrl()` used `emailData.site_url` (the app domain) as the base — GoTrue hosts `/auth/v1/verify` on the Supabase project domain, so every confirm/magic-link/reset link 404'd. Now always built on `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` (`app/api/auth/hook/route.ts`)

changelog.title: Login error masking by Supabase CAPTCHA
changelog.detail: All auth flows (directory login, magic link, signup, password reset, admin login) failed with `captcha_failed` but fell through to a generic "Something went wrong". Root cause: Supabase Auth CAPTCHA enabled while admin login sent no `captchaToken`; error mapping had no `captcha` case. Added `captcha` handling everywhere + consolidated error mapping into single source of truth (`lib/auth/auth-errors.ts`)

changelog.title: Admin login CAPTCHA support
changelog.detail: Previously sent zero Turnstile — hardcoded "Invalid email or password" masked real errors. Now includes Turnstile widget + `captchaToken` passthrough on both password + magic link actions (`app/admin/login/actions.ts`, `app/admin/login/login-form.tsx`)

changelog.title: Lint was dead repo-wide

Added `eslint.config.mjs` (eslint-config-next 16.2.0 flat config), switched the script to `eslint .`, and fixed all **58 errors** it surfaced (46 unused vars/imports, 11 from a `ToolBtn` nested inside render in the rich-text editor, 1 TDZ/immutability in `theme-provider`).
